risks.reasoning: The accountants' report shows negative operating cash flow in each selected reporting period, but cash and cash equivalents were sufficient for more than 12 months of operating cash burn in every period tested. The minimum calculated runway is approximately 23.40 months (2019), so none of the frozen <12, <6, or <3 month thresholds is met.

The audited historical financial information records losses for both comparable annual periods (2019 and 2020) and both comparable three-month periods (Q1 2020 and Q1 2021). There are two comparable loss periods in each duration set, meeting the frozen medium threshold of two comparable periods, but no set of three comparable loss periods is disclosed to support high.

Comparable revenue increased in both available comparisons: 2020 versus 2019 and Q1 2021 versus Q1 2020. Both calculated growth rates are positive, so neither the frozen medium threshold (<0%) nor the high threshold (<=-20%) is met.

For the three months ended 31 March 2021, Customer G generated RMB5.025 million of the group's RMB7.883 million revenue, or approximately 63.74%. This exceeds the frozen 50% largest-customer high threshold. The Business section independently cross-checks the rounded largest-customer share at 63.7% and top-five customer share at 88.7%, both of which also satisfy high thresholds.

The Business section discloses that the five largest suppliers represented 68.3% of total purchases in 2019, which exceeds the frozen 60% top-five medium threshold but remains below the 80% high threshold. The largest supplier was 26.2%, below the 30% largest-supplier medium threshold. Concentration declined in 2020 and Q1 2021, but the disclosed 2019 track-record period establishes a medium-level concentration instance.

TERMINATION_RESTORATION_AMBIGUITY: the accountants' report records a contractual redemption feature under which A, B and C preferred shareholders could require repurchase if a qualified IPO had not occurred by 31 December 2023. The pre-IPO investment disclosure separately states that preferred shareholders no longer held redemption rights after the listing application was submitted and that special rights would not survive listing. The prospectus evidence reviewed does not clearly state whether the redemption feature would be restored if the listing did not complete. Under the frozen protocol, unclear termination/restoration requires needs_review with provisional medium severity.

The Business section states that through the Latest Practicable Date the group was not involved in any actual or, to its knowledge, threatened material legal or administrative proceedings, had no material EHS fines or penalties, and had obtained all material licences, approvals and permits necessary for its operations. The disclosed 2023 drug manufacturing licence renewal was expected to face no impediment and had no significant GMP compliance findings.

The Business section identifies MSB2311 as the core product and states it would be further evaluated in a Phase II study. Financial Information states that the group had no products approved for commercial sale and had generated no product-sales revenue. These facts establish the precommercial-product candidate. POLICY_AMBIGUITY (OPEN-02): Protocol v1.1.1 leaves severity for precommercial_product unfrozen, so expected_level is null rather than guessed.

These audited historical revenue figures provide the numerator and denominator facts for 2019-to-2020 and Q1 2020-to-Q1 2021 comparable growth calculations.
